title: Kourovka Notebook Problem 21.126
exact_target: Find finitely presented subgroups of right-angled Artin groups with either faster-than-exponential filling or slower-than-exponential filling that still exceeds every polynomial.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2635 (KOU-21.126). CC BY 4.0.
